name: Haji-Mari
source:
Me and my little sister Mari talked about things together, even very secret things. 

I was still surprised when she brought up sex. 

What happened, little sister? 
Of course she's at that age. 
But, to ask me... me!? For advice? What should I do? 

"Just let me do it with you," she said with a bashful face. "Teach me the real thing!" 

Mari was being so forceful. 
It was so unlike her. I was so turned on.

translation:
我和妹妹真理谈论各种事情，甚至包括非常私密的话题。

可当她提到性爱时，我还是吃了一惊。

怎么了，妹妹？
她当然到了那个年龄。
可她竟然来问我……问我！？让我给建议？我该怎么办？

“让我和你做吧。”她红着脸说，“教我真正的性爱！”

真理表现得如此强势，与平时判若两人。我兴奋不已。
